about: Round 3 of the second source (2026-11-22): the stories, designs and periods from round 2, now WITH the text on record ('record'), because round 2's sheet did not show it and an 'agree' could not be judged. Check every sentence of 'record' against a source other than 'source_on_record'. All of it holds: one line with new = record exactly and source 'agree: <what you checked, with the page>'. A sentence is wrong: one line with new = the whole record text with only that sentence corrected, and the source for the correction. Use 'entity', 'id' and 'field' exactly as given.
